hypothesis.method: Self-conditioned diffusion models with adaptive feedback loops from human-AI interaction traces
hypothesis.problem: Generative AI systems exhibit inconsistent alignment with nuanced human intent during multi-turn creative tasks
hypothesis.goal: Achieve persistent, context-aware adaptation of generative outputs to individual user creative styles without explicit retraining

messages.content: Propose one novel and scientifically valid research hypothesis in the field of artificial intelligence, in particular generative AI. Express it as three short phrases: a Method (the technique to be used), a Problem (the problem to be addressed), and a Goal (the property to be improved). Answer only with a JSON object of the form {"method": "...", "problem": "...", "goal": "..."} and nothing else.
